summary: Closed the post-claim STARTED transport ambiguity without changing ownership semantics. CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED is now explicitly pre-authority only. After a deterministic PIN/claim wins, canonical STARTED remains primary; if STARTED persistence is blocked, one worker/job-scoped prometeo.worker-heartbeat/v1 with checkpoint POST_CLAIM_START_FALLBACK is the durable liveness fallback. Live already consumes that heartbeat in last_signal_at while the PIN remains sole execution authority. If both post-claim signals are blocked, substantive mutation is forbidden and the silent owner is left to normal stale/recovery handling rather than falsely becoming no-allocation.
